title: Product
description: E-commerce product with name, description, pricing, category, brand, SKU, stock availability, and image. Used for online stores, product catalogs, and inventory management systems.

name.description: Product name or title displayed to customers

description.description: Detailed product description including features, specifications, and benefits

price.description: Product price in the specified currency

currency.description: ISO currency code for the product price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

category.description: Product category or classification (e.g., Electronics, Clothing, Books, Home & Garden)

brand.description: Brand or manufacturer name of the product

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit - unique product identifier used for inventory tracking and order management

stock.description: Current available stock quantity available for purchase

image.description: URL to the product's main image or photo
